description:
President Donald Trump has revived two rallies that were previously scrapped in the final days of the midterm campaign. 

Now, Trump plans to hold events in Kansas and Iowa on Sunday, according to a White House official and a Republican official. The officials said the rallies were rearranged to accommodate several telerallies. 

The Kansas rally was originally scheduled for Saturday before Trump said he was no longer going because GOP Sen. Roger Marshall was “doing really well.” Polls have shown Marshall in an unexpectedly tight race. 

Trump lashed out at a reporter Thursday who questioned the president about his health and asked if he was sick of traveling. He called the reporter “disgusting.”

Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, suspended withdrawals after hackers broke into its digital wallets and stole $6 billion in what appears to be the biggest crypto heist ever. 

Binance said late Thursday that its initial investigation indicated the hack went through an engineer’s laptop, “which allowed an attacker to gain access to a service container and submit unauthorized withdrawal transactions.” 

A team of cryptocurrency firms managed to freeze about $3 billion of the stolen loot amid a frenetic battle with the hackers to find and control the digital money. 

CNN's Clare Duffy reports and cryptocurrency experts Carol Alexander and Jonathan Levin weigh in on who may have been responsible for the hack.
